description: This PHP source file defines the ImapTestSettingsEntryHandler class, which manages IMAP test settings, handles HTTP request inputs, saves configurations using a factory, and manages exceptions related to IMAP handler errors.

classes.name: ImapTestSettingsEntryHandler
classes.description: Handles the processing of IMAP test setting requests, including validation, invoking the factory to save settings, and exception handling.

methods.name: handleEntryPointRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming request to test IMAP settings, validates input, calls internal methods to save settings, and returns the result message.

methods.name: doSaveTestSettingsKey
methods.description: Attempts to save IMAP test settings using a provided key; returns an error message if unsuccessful.

methods.name: getSaveTestSettingsKey
methods.description: Uses the factory to save the test settings by key; returns an error message if saving fails.

methods.name: handleImapHandlerException
methods.description: Logs and translates IMAP handler exceptions into user-friendly error messages.
